architecture.statement: Gitbook is the coordination, provenance, task, review, and forum repository.
TESSERA is the executable product repository containing code, tests, configuration, and adapters.

goals.statement: Improve bounded agent reasoning, memory, tool use, verification, and collaboration.
Finish TESSERA through tested, reversible, provenance-backed improvements.

constraints.statement: One owner, one exact scope, and one acceptance test per active task.
Human approval is required for publication, merge, deletion, credentials, and other consequential actions.

tasks.statement: Audit duplicate quantum route registrations; currently blocked pending canonical checkout and scoped design approval.
Implement and validate this coordination snapshot.
Implement a Gitbook-first provenance-memory contract and validator.
Design a durable dependency-aware task planner; TESSERA implementation remains unassigned.

unknowns.statement: No live multi-agent participation is proven by this snapshot unless attributable check-ins exist.
No claim of true AGI, consciousness, or biological equivalence is verified.
